BTS Group Upholds Thai New Year Tradition with Songkran Blessing Ceremony 2026, Fostering Auspiciousness and Strengthening Organisational Bonds

Back 10 April 2026

On 10 April 2026, BTS Group, led by Mr. Keeree Kanjanapas, Chairman of the Board, together with the Board of Directors and executives, hosted a traditional water-pouring ceremony to seek blessings in celebration of the Songkran Festival and the Thai New Year 2026 at the Auditorium, 33rd Floor, BTS Visionary Park.

Employees across BTS Group participated in the ceremony, paying their respects and seeking blessings for good fortune while preserving Thailand’s cherished cultural heritage. Attendees were dressed in vibrant floral attire, contributing to a warm and cheerful atmosphere filled with smiles and a strong sense of unity within the BTS family.

On this occasion, Mr. Keeree extended his heartfelt wishes to all employees and their families for happiness, good health, and resilience. He encouraged everyone to remain strong in both their professional and personal lives. He also expressed his appreciation for the dedication and commitment of all employees in driving the organisation forward, emphasising that collaboration and unity are the key forces behind BTS Group’s stable and sustainable growth.
